t: A paid K-12 platform with AI tutors, lessons, and report cards for homeschools.
steps: Find LittleLit on its official site and review the current pricing.
Read the privacy policy and the consent steps before creating any account.
Ask IT and school leaders whether a paid cloud tool fits school data rules.
A parent or school creates the main account.
Create student accounts with consent and use an alias for each child.
Try one lesson as an adult first.
